refName.description: The full ref name, e.g. refs/heads/main.

objectId.description: The hex SHA-256 object ID this ref points to.

main.description: A did-git ref stored in an AT Protocol repository. Each record maps a ref name (e.g. refs/heads/main) to the hex SHA-256 object ID it points to. The record key is the ref name with slashes replaced by underscores.
